generations.name: First generation (STLA Large)
generations.notes: 100.5 kWh, 400 V, 131 Ah NMC cells (Jeep spec sheet), 5-80 % DC in about 28 min; peak quoted 160-220 kW by different outlets. Same STLA Large pack as the Wagoneer S per CarGurus. MY2026 (MOAB 4x4) in EPA and NRCan. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://s3.amazonaws.com/chryslermedia.iconicweb.com/mediasite/specs/2026_JP_Recon_SPr6smtuph2d3ggbf6vn6sejdcii.pdf ; https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/articles/2026-jeep-recon-pricing-specs-release-date
